## ✨ Highlights

A Controller that knows the newest release even on a slow first start,
and fresh components underneath.

- 🖥️ **The newest release first**: a Controller starting for the first
  time while GitHub is slow knows the newest release and the
  pre-release at once, the security details following.
- 📦 **zlib 1.4** in HAProxy, newer Go modules, frontends rebuilt on
  current libraries.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- Nothing to do.

## 🖥️ Controller

- **The newest release read before the security files**
  ([#615](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/615)): a Controller
  starting without its `release-cache.json` while GitHub answered in 4
  seconds spent its whole read on some 60 `security.json` and knew no
  release for 5 minutes (the pre-release for 3, at 1 second a request -
  v2026.11.09-3's lab campaign). It now reads the newest release, its
  maintenance releases and the pre-release first, then the
  `security.json` newest first with the time left - the rest a few
  minutes later.
- **The Update page reads the slots again after a refusal**: a refused
  update can leave the other slot holding part of the release, and the
  page showed the slot as it was until a reload.

## 📦 Components

- **zlib 1.3.2 → 1.4** in HAProxy
  ([#577](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/577)), checked with
  gzip and deflate compression; the two vulnerabilities it fixes don't
  apply to Janus (HAProxy only uses zlib's in-memory deflate).
- **Go modules**: go-jose 4.1.9, golang.org/x/oauth2 0.38,
  golang.org/x/sys 0.50 ([#619](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/619));
  the Go 1.27.3 image the Controller and node_exporter are built in,
  refreshed ([#616](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/616)).
- **The Controller's pages and the image factory's site** rebuilt on
  lucide-react 1.70, Vite 8.3.6 and @vitejs/plugin-react 6.2.1; the docs
  on Astro 7.4.7 and Starlight 0.42.10
  ([#624](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/624)).

## 🧪 Tests and tooling

- Test tools: OpenTofu 1.13.9, versitygw 1.11.0, RouterOS CHR 7.25.1,
  Keycloak 26.8.2, Prometheus 3.16.0, Playwright 1.65, Node 24.22.2 for
  the docs' build, oxlint 1.92.
- The v2026.11.09-3 pre-release's lab campaign
  ([#614](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/614)): the Update page's
  live progress, the release cache across a restart.
